```{r library-and-datasheets}
#| echo: False #Added to prevent the printing of excess code
#| warning: False #Added to prevent the printing of excess code

required_packages <-function(...) { 
  libs<-unlist(list(...)) 
  req<-suppressMessages(suppressWarnings(unlist(lapply(libs,require,character.only=TRUE)))) 
  need<-libs[req==FALSE] 
  if(length(need)>0){ 
    install.packages(need, repos = "http://cran.us.r-project.org") 
    lapply(need, library, character.only=TRUE) 
  }
  else{message("No packages required installation.")} 
}

required_packages("tidyverse", "readxl", "writexl", "lme4", "lmerTest", "ggeffects", "emmeans", "generics", "ggrepel", "broom", "DHARMa")

Hydric_Phys <- read_xlsx("Hydric_Physiology.xlsx")
CEWL_Data <- read_xlsx("CEWL_Values.xlsx")
okabe_ito <- c(
  "#E69F00", # orange
  "#56B4E9") # blue
```

```{r checking-cewl}
#Check to see if they are all within their own mean or beyond
CEWL_Data |> 
  group_by(Indiv_Lizard) |> 
  mutate(IDMean = mean(`TEWL [g/(m2h)]`),
         IDSD   = sd(`TEWL [g/(m2h)]`),
         In2SD = (`TEWL [g/(m2h)]` >= IDMean - 2 * IDSD) &
           (`TEWL [g/(m2h)]` <= IDMean + 2 * IDSD)) |> 
  ungroup() |> 
  summarize(Within2SD = sum(In2SD, na.rm = TRUE),
            Outside2SD = sum(!In2SD, na.rm = TRUE)) 
#average CEWL values & find cv
CEWL_Average <- CEWL_Data |> 
  group_by(Indiv_Lizard) |> 
  mutate(CEWL = mean(`TEWL [g/(m2h)]`),
         CEWL_cv = sd(`TEWL [g/(m2h)]`, na.rm = TRUE) 
         /mean(`TEWL [g/(m2h)]`, na.rm = TRUE) * 100) |>
  summarize(
    across(
      c(`AmbT [C]`,	`AmbRH [%]`, CEWL, CEWL_cv),
      mean, .names = "{.col}_mean"), .groups = "drop")
```

```{r join the data}
Lizard_Data_All <- Hydric_Phys |> 
  full_join(CEWL_Average,
            by = "Indiv_Lizard") |> 
  mutate(SexGravid = paste(Sex, `Gravid?`, sep = "_"),
         Es = 0.611 * exp((17.502*`AmbT [C]_mean`)/(`AmbT [C]_mean`+240.97)),
         Lab_VPD = Es - (Es*(`AmbRH [%]_mean`/100))) |> 
  select(!Es) |> 
  filter(!Sex == "J") |> 
  mutate(Campus = dplyr::recode(Campus,
                                "SCR" = "Scripps",
                                "CSM" = "CSUSM"),
         LizardID = str_replace(LizardID, "_0", "_")) |> 
  dplyr::rename(Posm_mean = Avg_Posm)

Lizard_Data_All$SiteSeason <- interaction(Lizard_Data_All$Site, Lizard_Data_All$Season)

```


```{r filter data cewl}
CEWL_outliers <- Lizard_Data_All |>
  group_by(Site, Season) |>
  mutate(Q1 = quantile(CEWL_mean, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE), 
         Q3 = quantile(CEWL_mean, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
         IQR = Q3 - Q1,
         outlier = CEWL_mean < (Q1 - 1.5 * IQR) |
                   CEWL_mean > (Q3 + 1.5 * IQR)) |> 
  ungroup()

CEWL_outliers |> 
  filter(outlier) |>
  select(LizardID, Site, Season, CEWL_mean)

ggplot(CEWL_outliers, aes(x = Season, y = CEWL_mean, color = Site)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  geom_label_repel(
    data = subset(CEWL_outliers,
                  outlier == "TRUE", force = 1, 
                  na.rm = TRUE),
    aes(label = Indiv_Lizard), size = 3)+
  geom_point(data = subset(CEWL_outliers, outlier == TRUE), color = "red")

```

```{r read in SVL}
SVL <- read_xlsx("Cool Lizards SVL.xlsx") |> 
  select(!"...9") |> 
  mutate(
    `Liz ID` = str_replace_all(`Liz ID`, "on", "ON"),
    `Liz ID` = str_replace_all(`Liz ID`, "off", "OFF"),
    `Liz ID` = str_replace_all(`Liz ID`, " ", "")
  ) |> 
  filter(!`Liz ID` %in% c(
    "CSUSB_ON_01_0003",   # replicate of Off_01, mislabeled
    "CP_OFF_12_0001",     # crooked, use the other scan
    "CSUSB_ON_06_0001",   # a replicate with a hand in the way
    "UCLA_OFF_01_0002",   # dorsal replicate
    "PEP_ON_51_0001",     # replicate
    "CP_OFF_03_0001",     # crooked
    "CP_OFF_12_0002",     # unneeded dorsal measurment
    "CSUSB_OFF_04_0001"
  )) |> 
  mutate(
    `Liz ID` = str_remove(`Liz ID`, "_000[1234]$"),
    `Liz ID` = str_replace(`Liz ID`, "_0([0-9]+)$", "_\\1"),
    Site = str_extract(`Liz ID`, "ON|OFF"),
    `Liz ID` = str_replace(`Liz ID`,"PEP(?!P)","PEPP"),
    `Liz ID` = str_replace(`Liz ID`,"SC(?!R)","SCR")) |> 
    #Campus = str_extract(`Liz ID`, "SDSU|CP|CLU|CSM|CSUSM|CSULB|CSUSB|HMC|PEPP|SCR|SC|UCLA|PEP|WC") originally used for combining datasheet & locating errors. Ignore this line
  rename(LizardID = `Liz ID`) |> 
  mutate(SiteSeason = interaction(Site, Season)) |> 
  select(!c("SVL 1","SVL 2", "SVL3", "STDEV", "CV")) |> 
  dplyr::rename(SVL = `Average`)

Combined_Lizard <- left_join(Lizard_Data_All, SVL,
                             by = c("LizardID","Site","Season", "SiteSeason"))
  
Condition_Model <- lm(log(Mass) ~ log(SVL), data = Combined_Lizard, na.action = na.exclude)

Lizard_Master <- Combined_Lizard |> 
  mutate(Sion = Mass / SVL,
         Pieg = log(Mass) - predict(Condition_Model, newdata = Combined_Lizard),
         Condition = residuals(Condition_Model)) #this is the exact same as "Pieg", different format
#Scaled Mass Index?

  #write_xlsx("Missing SVL.xlsx")
```

```{r}
#| warning: FALSE

Lizard_Master_con_outlier <- Lizard_Master |> 
  mutate(condition_outlier = "no")

library(broom)

augments_df <- augment(Condition_Model, data = Combined_Lizard)

Lizard_Master_con_outlier <- augments_df |> 
  select(Indiv_Lizard, .std.resid) |> 
  right_join(Lizard_Master_con_outlier, 
             by = "Indiv_Lizard") |> 
  mutate(condition_outlier = ifelse(abs(.std.resid) > 3, "YES", "NO"))

ggplot(data = Lizard_Master_con_outlier, 
             aes(x = SVL, y = Mass)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = condition_outlier), show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_label_repel(
    data = subset(Lizard_Master_con_outlier,
                  condition_outlier == "YES", force = 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    aes(label = Indiv_Lizard))+
  theme_bw()+
  labs(title = "Body Condition Outliers")
```

```{r}
                      Season + Site + Condition + scale(Posm_mean) +
                      Site:Season + Site:Condition + Season:Condition +
                      scale(Posm_mean):Site +

                      (1|Campus) + (1|Site:Campus),
                      data = CEWL_data_clean, REML = F)

                       Season + Site + Condition +
                       Season:Site + Site:Condition + Season:Condition +
                       SexGravid +
                       (1|Season:Campus) + (1|Site:Campus),
                       data = Posm_data_clean, REML = F)
```

```{r run models}
options(na.action = "na.omit")
# Season*Site + Season*Condition + Site*Condition
lmer_CEWL <- lmer(CEWL_mean ~ 
                  scale(Posm_mean) + Site +
                  Season*Condition +
                  Season:scale(Posm_mean):Site +
                  Lab_VPD + SexGravid  +
                 (1|Campus) + (1|Season:Campus)
                  #+ (1|Site:Campus)  
                 # (1|Site:Campus) had a VarCorr() stdDev of 0, contributing essentially nothing to the model. Thus, it was removed
                  , data = filter(Lizard_Master,!is.na(CEWL_mean)), REML = F)


lmer_CEWL <- lmer(CEWL_mean ~ 
                    Season + Site + Condition + scale(Posm_mean) +
                    # Site:Season + #Either or!
                    #Site:Condition + #Either or!
                    Season:Condition +   
                    Lab_VPD + SexGravid +
                    (1|Campus) + (1|Season:Campus)
                  , data = filter(Lizard_Master,!is.na(CEWL_mean)), REML = F)



anova(lmer_CEWL) 
pairs(emmeans(lmer_CEWL, specs = ~ Site|Season))
pairs(emmeans(lmer_CEWL, specs = ~ SexGravid))

lmer_Posm <- lmer(Posm_mean ~ 
                  Site +
                  Season * Condition +
                  #Season*Site + Season*Condition + Site*Condition + #Unused as of now
                  SexGravid +
                  (1|Site:Campus) + (1|Season:Campus)
                 #+ #1|Campus had a VarCorr() stdDev of 0, contributing essentially nothing to the model and causing "boundary (singular) fit". Thus, it was removed
                  ,
                  data = filter(Lizard_Master, !is.na(Posm_mean)), REML = F)
anova(lmer_Posm)
pairs(emmeans(lmer_Posm, specs = ~ Site))
emtrends(lmer_Posm, pairwise ~ Season, var = "Condition")

lmer_Hem <- lmer(Hematocrit ~ 
                 Season*Site*Condition +
                # Season*Site + Season*Condition + Site*Condition + #Unused
                 SexGravid + 
                 (1|Campus) + (1|Season:Campus) + (1|Site:Campus)
                 # had a VarCorr() stdDev of 0, contributing essentially nothing to the model and causing "boundary (singular) fit". Thus, it was removed
                 ,
                 data = filter(Lizard_Master, !is.na(Hematocrit)), REML = F)
anova(lmer_Hem)
pairs(emmeans(lmer_Hem, specs = ~ Site|Season))
emtrends(lmer_Hem,
         ~ Season * Site,
         var = "Condition")
      
lmer_Con <- lmer(Condition ~
                 Season + Site + SexGravid +
                 scale(Posm_mean) +
                 Hematocrit +
                 (1|Site:Campus) + (1|Campus),
                 data = filter(Lizard_Master, !is.na(Condition)), REML = F)
anova(lmer_Con)

```

```{r}
CEWL_Model <- emmeans(lmer_CEWL, ~ Season*Site) %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  mutate(Season = factor(Season, levels = c("Spring", "Fall")), 
         Site = dplyr::recode(Site, "ON" = "On", "OFF" = "Off"), 
         Response = "CEWL")
Hemato_Model <- emmeans(lmer_Hem, ~ Season*Site) %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  mutate(Season = factor(Season, levels = c("Spring", "Fall")), 
         Site = dplyr::recode(Site, "ON" = "On", "OFF" = "Off"),
         Response = "Hematocrit")
Posm_Model <- emmeans(lmer_Posm, ~ Season*Site) %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  mutate(Season = factor(Season, levels = c("Spring", "Fall")), 
         Site = dplyr::recode(Site, "ON" = "On", "OFF" = "Off"),
         Response = "Plasma Osmolality")

All_Models <- bind_rows(Posm_Model, CEWL_Model, Hemato_Model) %>%
  mutate(Response = factor(Response, levels = c("CEWL", "Plasma Osmolality", "Hematocrit")))
```


```{r}
ggplot(CEWL_Model, aes(x = Season, y = emmean, color = Site, group = Site)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_line() +
  #geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = lower.CL, ymax = upper.CL), size = 1, width = 0.2) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = (emmean + SE), ymax = (emmean - SE)), size = 1, width = 0.2) +
  labs(y = expression("Predicted CEWL (g "* m^-2 / h^-1 *")")) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(),
        axis.line = element_line(color = "black"),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 20),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 16),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 16),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 18)) +
  scale_color_manual(
    labels = c("Non-Urban", "Urban"),
    values = c(okabe_ito[1], okabe_ito[2]))
```

```{r}
SexGravitity_graph <- emmeans(lmer_CEWL, ~ SexGravid) %>% 
  as.data.frame() |> 
  mutate(SexGravid = case_when(SexGravid == "F_Y" ~ "Pregnant Female",
                               SexGravid == "F_N" ~ "Non-Pregnant Female",
                               SexGravid == "M_N/A" ~ "Male"))

ggplot(SexGravitity_graph, aes(x = SexGravid, y = emmean)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = lower.CL, ymax = upper.CL), 
                width = 0.2, size = 1)
```
